Major Features
,
Combat System 0.3.0
Beta weapons (most functional), hit FX/sounds/camera shakes, primary/secondary swaps, rebalances, scanner detection.

Survival Needs System 0.3.5
Hunger/thirst/satiation/hydration/stamina drain, eat/drink/food items, low-health limp, PVP/fall damage, hospital respawn.

Resource Gathering 0.3.5
Early collection (bushes/mushrooms), navigation markers for test zones.

PVE Invasion System 0.3.6/0.3.8
Terra drone hunts (63/spawning per Solace, Light/Med/Heavy tiers), tunnel fights.

PVP Arena System 0.3.6
Lawless zones (e.g., industrial tank arena), unlimited ammo spawns.

Movement System 0.3.0
Procedural terrain adaptation, motion matching animations, jetpack leans/flight (GTI/Core Dynamics models).

Day/Night Cycle 0.3.2
Accelerated to 4 real-time hours/game day for dynamic lighting/events.

Economy System 0.3.0/0.3.6
Shops/ammo stations (Calido/Solace), buying/selling functional.

Housing System 0.3.6
Apartment previews/real estate office (The Reserve), build kits integration.

Land Ownership System 0.3.6
Plot signs (rarity/claim status) for player districts.

Training Hotzones 0.3.0/0.3.2
Defense Academy (Terra Tunnel sims/shooting ranges), Speed Runner mini-game, Rumble Ball revamp.

Exploration System 0.3.0
100+ Holocaches, expanded zones (Calido/Esperanza previews/mines), updated nav/maps.

Major Accomplishments
,
Engine Power-Up & Summit Spotlight 
Upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.6 for stellar performance, animations, and rendering. Showcased at C Play Summit in Vegas with Hydra Doom Tournament—putting blockchain gaming on the map.

SuperVerse Alliance & Movement Mastery 
Partnered with SuperVerse to unify ecosystems and expand $RISE utility. Teased motion matching upgrades for ultra-realistic gameplay.

Trailers, Builds & Pre-Alpha Peaks (0.3.0/0.3.1/0.3.2 Releases) 
Dropped "The Calm Before the Storm" teaser and full trailer. Released build 0.3.0 with Avatar 3.0, beta combat, Rumble Ball revamp, ray tracing, and community file nodes. Hotfixed 0.3.1 for performance boosts. Then 0.3.2 added Nvidia DLSS/Frame Gen, Speed Runner mini-game, SK-47 Rifle, Core Dynamics Jetpacks (AlienX/GlideSport), Comet M42 Shoes, and shortened day/night cycles.

Pioneered Community-Run File Nodes for Game Delivery 
0.3.0 "Before the Storm" launched entirely via proprietary node infrastructure—decentralized delivery of our most ambitious build yet, bypassing traditional cloud services.

Solace Land Grab Legacy & Phase 3 Sales 
Historic event: 814,050 entries, 7,135 plots claimed across Zones 1-3 by 1,424 pioneers. Livestreamed with giveaways—89% claim rate! Dropped Comet M42 Shoes, free Superverse Tiger M9-S, Juggernaut vault items.

Rebrand Revolution & "The Ascent" (0.3.5 Release) 
Teased/revealed "The Ascent" via AMA. Rebranded to Infinity Rising with new site/blog. Dropped 0.3.5: Player Needs System (eat/drink/survive/PVP/death), early gathering, FSR support. Sales: Rando’s Sunset Speeder racer, Zero G Stratos Backpack, Tier 1 Hub City Apartments (2,500 keys).

Apartment Expansions & Build Kits 
Tier 2 Apartments + Premium/Mythic Build Kits (e.g., Modern Log Cabin, Harvest themes). Wishlisting live on Epic Games Store and Steam—paving the way for massive visibility.

Winter Invasion & Mythical Christmas Blitz (0.3.6/0.3.8 Releases) 
0.3.6 brought first PVE Terra Drones, The Reserve (apartment previews/real estate), secret PVP Arena. 0.3.8 unleashed 63-drone invasions per Solace (Light/Med/Heavy tiers with scanner hunts), new weapons (S92/Sentinel 45), Kazekura Shinobi-X racer, and full Christmas sale integration (File Nodes B2G1, Holiday Kits, Crimson Clause Outfits, Gift-Wrapped Cargo Packs). Marketplace Update
,
The Komaru Double Dragon 28 Gauge, Tier 2 Hub City Apartments, and the Comet M42 sneakers are back in the marketplace for a limited time.

The Komaru Double Dragon 28 Gauge is a compact shotgun pistol built for moments where distance disappears and decisions must be final. Chambered in 28 gauge with twin barrels, it is designed to end close range encounters fast. Its break action keeps reloads simple and reliable, while the extended frame and ergonomic grip help control recoil and keep shots on target. This is a specialist sidearm intended for room entries, last second defenses, and situations where your primary weapon runs dry.

Tier 2 Hub City Apartments are also available again. These units offer a stronger foothold in the city, expanded utility over lower tiers, and entry into the Tier 2 Prize Pool with each purchase. Priced at 119 dollars per unit, they are a core option for players looking to establish a more permanent presence.

The Comet M42 sneakers return as the first ever custom sneaker with its own rarity run. These high performance shoes provide speed and jump boosts, with additional buffs unlocking in upcoming releases, making them a long term mobility investment rather than a simple cosmetic.

All of these items are available for an undisclosed amount of time and may be removed without notice. If any of them have been on your list, this is your window to act.
https://infinityrising.com/marketplace

The Kargo Express XL is now live in the marketplace.
,
Built for players who move a lot of materials and still value mobility. Following the Titan XL, the Kargo Express XL delivers serious storage through a reinforced frame and hard case design, with a key upgrade that changes how it feels in use. Dual side mounted jet boosters help you cover ground faster and reposition smoothly even when fully loaded.

This pack is ideal for resource runs, mission hauling, and longer exploration loops where a standard pack falls short. You get the extra room without feeling like a walking crate, keeping your movement fluid while carrying more back with you.

The Kargo Express XL makes it clear you are here to work, travel, and return loaded.

If you are constantly running out of space or juggling speed versus storage, this is one to grab while it's available:

Howdy folks.... 

Now that we are all back in the full swing of things, my goal for the marketing team is to dial in more processes for content creation. In December we added a new content channel on Instagram, which has gone well so far. 

Now, I'm shifting into processes for tiktok. We are nearly ready to start posting consistently. One thing we need more of is funny/blooper type content from your gaming sessions so that we can add these to longer form videos as well as shorts. 

I'd like to invite you to share video files in ⁠unknown if you would like to help. Please only upload clips that are a max of 20 seconds and make sure they showcase a "cool" moment that could be funny, goofy, exciting, scary etc. 

Other news.... 

Last month, I began testing meta ads for our wishlist initiative. I can happily say that it has gone really well so far. Yesterday, I shifted ads toward our "Boarding Pass" access form and we have received a ton of new access requests in just 24 hours. I'm looking to scale these performing ads up over the coming weeks. If you happen to see a new person in chat, be sure to welcome them. 

Generally speaking, my primary goal for our marketing this quarter is to onboard new players through our Boarding Pass page. This will allow us to add a new player base consistently over time. 

Happy New Year, 

Marketing Team

Nekobyte Outfit
A streetwear set that blends soft pastel tones with sharp gamer details. The oversized graphic tee, fitted skirt, layered accessories, and controller shaped belt bag feel pulled from both streaming culture and city nightlife, giving the outfit presence in busy spaces.

Nekobyte Shoes
High top street shoes with clean lines, a solid rubber sole, and confident color blocking. They feel grounded and natural in motion, anchoring the look during walk cycles, idle moments, and casual movement across the city.
These pieces are designed to feel effortless while still standing out.

 NODE UPDATE – PUBLIC POOL REQUIREMENT CHANGE

To support the launch and operation of public node pools, the required number of nodes has been reduced from 8 to 6.

There is no change to the minimum RISE holding requirement. Node operators must still hold 15,000 RISE if you have 5 or more nodes in your pool.

This adjustment is intended to make public pools more accessible while maintaining the same economic and security standards.

Komaru Defense Outlaw .45 70 Law is Now LIVE
,
The Komaru Defense Outlaw .45 70 Law has arrived in the marketplace, built for players who value control, patience, and decisive fire over raw volume.

This lever fed marksman rifle blends classic repeating rifle handling with modern machining. The smooth cycling action and long barrel give it a steady rhythm, rewarding measured play and disciplined positioning.

Chambered in .45 70 Law, each round carries serious impact. A well placed shot can punish exposed targets, crack armor, or shut down an aggressive push before it fully develops. The traditional wood stock keeps the rifle stable under recoil, while the sight rail and tuned internals make it a natural fit for overwatch roles, elevated catwalks, and open field engagements.

The Outlaw is not built for rushing or panic fire. It is for players who pick their fights, hold their angles, and expect every trigger pull to matter.
